Note
OpenSearch and Elasticsearch version upgrades diﬀer from service software updates. For
information on updating the service software for your OpenSearch Service domain, see the
section called “Service software updates”.
Amazon OpenSearch Service oﬀers in-place upgrades for domains that run OpenSearch 1.0
or later, or Elasticsearch 5.1 or later. If you use services like Amazon Data Firehose or Amazon
CloudWatch Logs to stream data to OpenSearch Service, check that these services support the
newer version of OpenSearch before migrating.
